summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of the new BRSF Framework tab under /star-reward completed via Playwright as HR Admin. All acceptance criteria from the request are satisfied. Legacy Employees / Teams tabs remain fully functional (regression pass). Employee eligibility filter, 14-row parent grid, expandable child tables, totals, override validation, manual monthly/weekly entries, N07/N08 instance CRUD with sign guard, override-preserving recalculation, and audit trail dialog all work end-to-end against the real backend.

integration_issues.issue: 'Recalculate' completed successfully and preserved manual overrides (P03=+2, N07=-3 remained), but the success toast was not detected by the selector at time of check (toast likely auto-dismissed before the assertion). Non-blocking - functional behaviour is correct.

issues: MonthPicker rendered inside BrsfFramework does not propagate the passed data-testid='brsf-month-picker' onto its outer button, so month-picker element cannot be located by that testid (still visually present and works via UI). Testability nit - not a functional bug.

test_scenarios_verified: HR Admin login -> /star-reward: legacy tab-employees and tab-teams load their tables normally.
tab-brsf visible; clicking it renders month picker, brsf-employee-select and brsf-empty-state before any selection.
brsf-employee-select shows exactly Research Unit confirmed employees (24 options incl. Adhitya Charan, Adwaid Suresh, Anuj Kumar, Aparna A).
On selecting Adhitya Charan: 14 parent rows (P01-P06 + N01-N08) render, verified via subsequent brsf-row-<code> lookups AND full screenshot capture.
Expand/collapse works for P02, P05, N04, P06, N01, N02, N03, N05, N06, N07, N08 - child tables (brsf-child-table-<code>) appear with correct headers; row count remains 14 during expansions.
brsf-totals cards render Positive / Negative / Net; after edits: Positive +7, Net +3 (consistent with sums).

Override P01: value=-1 rejected with toast 'Positive criteria cannot hold a negative star value'; value=5 rejected with 'Maximum allowed is 2 star(s) for this criteria'; value=2 accepted -> status becomes 'Overridden', final=+2, brsf-reset-P01 button appears.
brsf-reset-P01 restores system value and status returns to 'Auto'.
Manual monthly P03: no entry-mode selector shown (monthly-only criteria); saving value 2 sets Final +2; reopening dialog pre-fills value 2 correctly.
Manual weekly P02: mode switched to Weekly, weeks 1/2/3 set to +1, saved -> Final +3; P02 becomes expandable and child table lists 5 weekly rows with correct stars.

N07 instance: positive value +1 rejected with 'Negative criteria cannot hold a positive star value'; -3 accepted; Final becomes -3; expanding N07 shows child row with brsf-edit-instance-N07-0 and brsf-delete-instance-N07-0 controls; delete removes the row.
Recalculate Automated Stars: request succeeds, P03 (+2 manual) and N07 (-3 instance) are preserved after recalculation - manual overrides not wiped.
Audit Trail dialog opens (brsf-audit-dialog) and lists 5 actions: override, reset, manual:monthly, manual:weekly, instance:add with previous/new values, reasons and 'admin' as updater.
Legacy 'Employees' and 'Teams' tabs remain fully functional after using BRSF tab (regression pass).
action_items: OPTIONAL/Minor: Ensure MonthPicker component forwards the `data-testid` prop to its trigger element so `brsf-month-picker` is queryable (currently not applied).
critical_code_review_comments: BrsfFramework.jsx (~580 lines) is on the higher side - could be split (OverrideDialog / ManualDialog / InstanceDialog into their own files) for maintainability.
In statusOf(), 'Not Applicable' is defined in STATUS_STYLE but never produced by statusOf() - dead style key.

Total rollup in patchLine() recomputes from `l.final_value` on the client and rounds to 2 decimals; this can transiently drift from server totals until next loadStars() call - low risk but worth aligning by re-fetching totals from server on line patch.

loadEmployees is invoked every time `getAuthHeaders` reference changes because it is a dependency; if AuthContext returns a new function on each render this may over-fetch. Consider memoising or using a stable ref.
seed_data_creation: Manual override on P01 (rolled back via reset); manual P03 monthly=2 (reset to 0 in cleanup); manual P02 weekly (weeks 1-3 = +1) left in place - only affects month 2026-09 for Adhitya Charan; N07 instance added and then deleted; audit trail rows remain for month 2026-09 / Adhitya Charan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BRSF tab is fully wired and stable. Test employee used: Adhitya Charan (EMP022), month 2026-09. Cleanup left P02 weekly manual (Wk1-Wk3 +1) in place; reset via brsf-manual-P02 -> monthly=0 if needed. Recalculate toast is fired but auto-dismisses fast (~2s) - keep this in mind when asserting.
